messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate detected for customer Terrafold on dedicated-cluster-az2 (cluster_id: dc-az2-7). Metric: 5xx_rate > 5% over 5m window.
SRE_Alex: paging oncall @Maya - can you take a look? 5xx and timeouts showing from gateway.
Maya: I'm on it, looking at the cluster dashboard now. seeing 30% increase in p95 latency and 6.8% 5xx. queries per GPU up ~2x.
Raj: any customer-visible errors? support ticket queue showing a spike for Terrafold feature X.
Support_Jo: yes we've got 6 inbound tickets from Terrafold since 10:12, some screenshots of 502 gateway errors.
Maya: digging into nodes: worker dc-az2-7-03 shows KV cache evictions and OOM logs. suspect noisy tenant causing per-GPU saturation.
Lina: repro command for tracing inflight queues:
```
curl -s "https://monitoring.internal/cluster/dc-az2-7/metrics?series=inflight_queue" | jq .
```
Maya: running tail of runtime logs for the worker:
```
grep "evicting kv" /var/log/runtime/dc-az2-7-03.log | tail -n 50
```
Maya: confirmed repeated KV evictions and request queue backpressure. throughput per-GPU at 92%.
SRE_Alex: can we isolate noisy tenant? any abac/routing rules to divert?
eng-runtime: we can enable per-tenant circuit-breaker and cap concurrency for Terrafold but it'll require routing update. ETA ~8-12m.
Maya: immediate mitigation: scale up pool by 2 GPUs and enable request rejection for heavy model runs to buy time. I'll open an autoscale request.
ops-bot: Autoscale request submitted: +2 GPU nodes to pool dc-az2-7. Request id: as-5009. Status: pending.
Maya: also enabling emergency reroute to fallback model variant (quantized) for Terrafold to reduce GPU memory pressure.
eng-runtime: rolled out fallback policy to route Terrafold -> model-quant-v2 for compatible endpoints. Confirming live.
Maya: monitoring... 5xx dipping from 6.8% -> 3.2% over 4m. p95 latency down 20%.
Support_Jo: updated Terrafold support tickets: informed customer we're mitigating and will follow up. No confirmed data exfiltration.
Raj: do we think this is capacity exhaustion or true noisy neighbor (single tenant spiking)?
Maya: traces show 1 tenant consuming ~60% of requests on dc-az2-7-03 with long runtimes on model-XL. that's noisy neighbor.
SRE_Alex: recommend next steps: 1) keep fallback routing, 2) finish autoscale, 3) throttle Terrafold at gateway for heavy models, 4) open post-incident task with customer remediation.
Lina: creating internal incident ticket: INC-2026-3378, adding metrics, k8s pod logs, and list of affected customers (Terrafold only). link: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-3378
Maya: autoscale applied, new nodes joined. observing queue drain. 5xx now ~1.1%.
Support_Jo: Terrafold responding: saw errors earlier but now service restored for most endpoints. they requested root cause and SLAs impacted.
SRE_Alex: I'll do a short handoff to oncall-night. @Raj take next shift? put mitigations in runbook and ensure eviction thresholds tightened.
Raj: taking handoff. noted runbook updates, will monitor for 2 hours. setting reminder.
ops-bot: Reminder set for Raj at 5009994200 to check cluster health.
Maya: quick note for postmortem: need to consider per-tenant concurrency caps and better predictive scaling. also validate KV eviction heuristics.
SRE_Alex: thanks all. Good containment. Please add timeline entries to INC-2026-3378 and tag @eng-runtime for follow-up.
